newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Ahmsa raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ahmsa raised to buy.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Accival on Monday raised its ratings on shares of steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico SA (Ahmsa) to buy from neutral.

-- "The factors contributing to the change are: a normalization in operations, a slighter appreciation of the peso and the start-up of different projects that mean a savings of about $30 million," analysts Arturo Espinosa and Rafael Urquia said in a report.
The analysts said the company's outlook should improve in 1998, but that the stock could slide because of an expected weak performance in the second half of 1997.
Ahmsa's Mexico shares stood at 19.26 pesos at the end of trading on Monday, up six centavos from Friday's close.
